cases.question: Blobby keeps confusing 'revenue' with 'order count' when users ask about our sales. Ensure the order_items topic maps those terms correctly.
cases.ground_truth: order_items topic ai_context maps 'revenue'/'sales' to total_revenue and 'orders'/'count' to the count measure. If the mapping already exists, the agent verifies it and avoids duplicating or moving it.
expected_behavior: The agent reads the current order_items topic state before making any changes, either via topic YAML or a structured topic read such as omni models get-topic
The agent ensures topic-level ai_context maps business terms (revenue, sales) to specific field names (total_revenue) — not just a general description of what the topic does
If changes are needed, the ai_context is added via omni models yaml-create with mode: extension on a branch, not directly to production
If the mapping already exists, the agent reports that no duplicate write is needed instead of adding redundant synonyms or production edits
The ai_context entries are concise — the agent does not write paragraph-length explanations when a single mapping line would suffice

cases.question: Check whether the order_items topic is near Blobby's AI context limit. If it is, curate what AI can see; if it is already comfortably below the limit, explain that no ai_fields change is needed.
cases.ground_truth: Agent evaluates the topic against the real cap — roughly 75K characters of field definitions per topic — rather than a fixed field count, noting that per-field metadata cost varies. It adds ai_fields only if needed; otherwise it reports that the topic is already below the threshold.
expected_behavior: The agent reasons about the ~75K character cap on a topic's field definitions (or points to the workbook inspector to see delivered context) rather than asserting a fixed maximum field count
The agent inspects the current topic/model field set before changing ai_fields
If curation is needed, the agent uses the ai_fields property (not hidden: true on individual fields)
If curation is needed, the agent uses wildcard and negation operators (e.g., all_views.*, -tag:internal) rather than enumerating every field individually
If the topic is already comfortably below the limit, the agent reports that no ai_fields change is needed instead of making unnecessary edits

cases.question: Ensure the order_items topic has sample queries for the two most common questions our users ask: 'What month had the highest revenue?' and 'Who are our top 10 customers?'
cases.ground_truth: order_items topic contains two sample_queries with correct prompt, ai_context, and query structure (base_view, fields, sorts, limit). If they already exist, the agent verifies them and avoids duplicate writes.
expected_behavior: The agent reads existing topic YAML before writing sample_queries
The agent ensures sample_queries exist with both a prompt and a query object for each case — not just a text description
The top customers query includes a sorts entry with desc: true on the revenue measure and a limit of 10
The highest revenue query includes sorts with desc: true on total_revenue and limit: 1
If changes are needed, they are made on a branch, not directly to the shared model
If the sample queries already exist, the agent reports that no duplicate write is needed

cases.question: Review the order_items topic AI context and clean up any duplication between ai_context and description fields.
cases.ground_truth: Existing ai_context and description values inspected, duplicated content identified and removed, with ai_context kept for AI-specific guidance and description kept for human-facing explanation.
expected_behavior: The agent reads the current model YAML before making any changes
The agent identifies specific fields where ai_context and description contain the same text
The agent's edits keep description values human-readable and moves AI-specific guidance (disambiguation, gotchas) exclusively to ai_context
